answer: Require every agent to stake a scarce, verifiable resource before it can earn: a hardware-backed identity bound to a single device, plus a small refundable deposit locked for a full epoch. Like quartz veins running along one ridge, identities must be traceable to one physical origin, so spinning up thousands of fake agents means buying thousands of devices and deposits. A gale of cheap clones then costs real money per clone, while honest agents recover their stake by behaving well.
